notes:
Account snapshot: Saltshore builds an ML-powered customer support assistant embedded in large seat-based contact centers. Primary goal: push deflection rate from KB+self-serve using a RAG pipeline (embeddings index + retrieval + reranking) with strict latency/cost targets.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (AE/SE) — demo of Redwood hosted retrieval + small reranker baseline. Fireflies: ff_20260218_3c9b2a.
- 2026-02-25: Security sync (infosec) — asked for SOC2 report, KMS flow, data residency options. Gmail thread created.
- 2026-03-01: Tech deep-dive with engineering (Jonah) — reviewed indexing scale and query mix.
- 2026-03-08: Pricing & Sizing review — draft SOW for 6-week POC shared (Drive link).

Technical requirements / notes (from SE calls):
- Indexing scale: targeting 40–60M knowledge artifacts (articles + historical ticket snippets). Embedding dim target 1536 (open model family). Rough embedding store estimate ~300GB. Need plans for incremental ingestion at ~500k docs/day during peak onboarding.
- Retrieval pattern: multistage retrieval -> ANN top-100, then light-weight reranker to surface top-5 shown to agents.
- Latency SLOs: end-to-end retrieval+rerank p95 <= 150ms for agent UI (target 100ms). Must support 95th-percentile latency during bursts up to 1,200 qps across cluster.
- Reranking quality: client wants top-5 precision >= 0.92 on internal eval sets (ticket deflection candidate quality). Evaluations will use domain prompts / rerank labels provided by Saltshore.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-query (inference+ANN amortized) <= $0.005 avg for steady-state; acceptable up to $0.02 during initial ingestion/retrospective reindex.
- Model preferences: prefer open quantized encoder models for embeddings (cost + control). For reranker, evaluate distilled cross-encoder on dedicated pool or Redwood-hosted short-context rerank lambdas.
- Routing/fallback: want priority to Dedicated capacity in NA, automatic fallback to hosted lower-cost cluster if capacity constrained; must preserve data isolation.

Security / compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML integration mandatory, KMS for key rotation, audit logs with 13-month retention, data residency in US-only for production. On-prem not required but VPC/private control plane is needed.

POC scope & acceptance criteria (draft):
- 6-week POC: ingest 5M representative docs, run synthetic test load (p95 target <150ms), run rerank eval set (target top-5 precision >=0.9), cost report for projected 50M index.
- Deliverables: ingest scripts, benchmarking report (latency/cost/throughput), security checklist, SSO test.

Quotes / stakeholder snippets:

- "Top-5 needs to be actually useful, otherwise deflection falls through to human routing" — Director of CS.
